exemplars.title: GeoVisA11y: An AI-based Geovisualization Question-Answering System for Screen-Reader Users
exemplars.why: The persistent interactive map and separate text-or-voice question-answering chat make both live regions explicit. The accessibility use case also demonstrates why a companion channel can materially expand access to a visual artifact without replacing it.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: Chosen over rid 2446 because its evidence identifies the artifact, conversational component, and user questioning behavior—not merely their side-by-side placement—and gives the pattern unusually consequential accessibility stakes.

exemplars.title: Debate Chatbots to Facilitate Critical Thinking on YouTube: Social Identity and Conversational Style Make A Difference
exemplars.why: A video remains visible on the left while an adjacent chat window supports conversation about it, closely matching the two-region structural signature. The debate-chatbot framing turns the panel into an instrument for critical engagement with otherwise passive media.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: Chosen over rid 4354 because it applies the same clear companion structure to critical interrogation of consumed media, a more distinctive interaction than soliciting feedback alongside an editor.

exemplars.title: Proxona: Supporting Creators' Sensemaking and Ideation with LLM-Powered Audience Personas
exemplars.why: The evidence explicitly pairs a persistent storyline editor with a conversation space where creators ask audience personas about that storyline. It is a clean, transferable example of grounding open-ended dialogue in an independently usable creative artifact.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: Chosen over rid 1524 because the quote explicitly scopes the conversation to the displayed storyline and adds the reusable mechanism of persona-mediated critique, whereas the UX-evaluation example establishes coexistence more clearly than conversational scope.

notes: The final three follow the consensus order; no selection was displaced. Scores were only lightly adjusted to reflect close inspection of structural fit, so no adjustment exceeds 0.3. Readers should distrust any stronger claim about optionality, unlimited multi-turn dialogue, or measured impact: the supplied evidence is limited to figure captions or brief system descriptions and does not directly establish all of those properties. Rid 2446 is the least structurally conclusive pick because its quote calls the right-hand region an audience chat window; its chatbot role and artifact scope depend partly on the paper title rather than the quoted passage alone.
